[[File:Hunters' sunlight crossbow detail.png|150px|left]]
The '''hunters' sunlight crossbow''' is an upgraded variant of the [[hunters' crossbow]] that requires level 66 [[Ranged]] and 50 [[Hunter]] to use. It is made with level 74 [[Fletching]] by using a [[sunlight antelope antler]] on the hunters' crossbow with a chisel in inventory.

The crossbow uses [[Sunlight antler bolts|sunlight]] or [[moonlight antler bolts]], and works with [[Mith grapple|grapples]]. Despite being an upgrade from the hunter's crossbow, it cannot be used to fire [[Kebbit bolts|kebbit]] or [[long kebbit bolts]].

As with other crossbows, the bolts fired from it roll against the enemy's heavy ranged defence,{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://x.com/JagexAsh/status/1796457655801893116|date=31 May 2024|quote=[Is the sunlight hunters' cbow considered heavy raged damage?] I believe so, if I'm reading my colleagues' code correctly.}} tying it with [[Karil's crossbow]] and [[chinchompa]]s as the fastest firing weapons to do so. Like the hunters' crossbow, it possesses an attack speed of 4 (3 on rapid), equal to a shortbow and faster than most other [[Crossbow (weapon)|crossbows]]. 

Due to its quick attack speed and the high strength bonus of its bolts, it is very effective against enemies where a crossbow is desirable but [[enchanted bolts]] are not needed.

==Trivia==
* The hunters' sunlight crossbow was originally proposed as the '''hunter's moonlight crossbow'''. As the name implies, it would have been crafted with a [[moonlight antelope antler]]. The original iteration had +5 Ranged accuracy over the [[hunters' crossbow]] (for a total of +60 accuracy) and fired [[moonlight antler bolts]], which originally had +85 Ranged Strength. However, to compensate, the weapon was polled as a 5 tick attack speed (4 on rapid).{{CiteNews|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/the-hunter-guild---varlamore?oldschool=1|title=The Hunter Guild - Varlamore|newsdate=11 September 2023|quote=We want to breathe some life into this neglected weapon by allowing skilled hunters to upgrade it to the Hunter’s Moonlight Crossbow using Moonlight Horns from moonlight antelopes. The upgraded version will require 66 Ranged and 50 Hunter to use, and 74 Fletching to craft. It comes with +5 Ranged accuracy at the cost of a slightly slower 5 attack speed (4 on Rapid). It also lets you use a new type of bolt crafted from Antelope Horns, with a powerful +85 Ranged strength bonus.}} This was changed to its current name and stats, using [[sunlight antelope antler]]s instead due to player feedback; the 91 Hunter requirement to hunt moonlight antelope was seen as disproportionately large compared to the weapon's power.
* Despite the item name being the '''Hunters' sunlight''' crossbow, the in-game skill guides and creation dialogue refer to it as the '''Sunlight hunters'''' crossbow, with the first two words being swapped.
